name: Vaultwarden

fields.label: Public vault URL
fields.description: Set the externally reachable URL. Existing admin-page config.json overrides environment settings.

fields.label: Allow new registrations
fields.description: Disable after creating your accounts; invitations remain available.

fields.label: Registration email domains
fields.description: Comma-separated domains allowed to register even when general registration is disabled.

fields.label: Administration token or Argon2 hash
fields.description: Protects /admin. An Argon2 PHC hash is recommended. Keep a separate backup of this credential.

fields.label: Require SSO for sign-in
fields.description: Keep disabled until your OIDC login has been tested. A vault master password is still required.

actions.label: Create SQLite snapshot
actions.description: Create a consistent database snapshot in /data. This does not include attachments, sends, configuration or encryption keys, and does not back up external SQL databases. Copy the snapshot and all remaining data to independent storage.

warnings: Settings changed through Vaultwarden /admin are stored in /data/config.json and override these environment values. Reconcile those overrides in Vaultwarden before expecting a Selfhost edit or OIDC connection to take effect.
The SQLite snapshot action excludes attachments, sends, keys and configuration. Back up the complete data volume separately.
